purpose: Teach: 同性/宣教師/レッテル/滅び/検察庁/結社/投融資/自虐

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、同性愛の歴史的研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you wrote your paper on the history of same-sex relationships, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, observational tone. Slight nod in the voice. Genuinely interested, not interrogating. Opening is steady and encouraging, like she's giving him space to speak.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、宣教師の渡来史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I focused on the historical arrival and writings of missionaries.
lines.style: Quiet, careful precision. Slight pause before the answer, like he's gathered his thoughts. Respectful but genuine. No performing, just clarity.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、社会的レッテルの問題を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And you explored the question of social labeling in that work, didn't you?
lines.style: Steady, reflective. A gentle follow-up, inviting him to go deeper. Warm but measured, like she's thinking alongside him rather than testing him.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、古代文明の滅びについて論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I examined how ancient civilizations collapsed under those pressures.
lines.style: Measured, intentional. Each phrase distinct and careful. He's thinking as he speaks, not reciting. Quiet sincerity underneath.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 検察庁の制度史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You also looked at the institutional history of the prosecution office, I recall?
lines.style: Attentive, genuinely remembering. A light conversational lilt on the opening. She's drawing connections, not checking boxes. Warm professional interest.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、戦時下の秘密結社の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I researched secret organizations during wartime and how their structures functioned.
lines.style: Steady, thoughtful tempo. He's present in each word. Slightly less guarded than before, gaining confidence. Quiet but assured.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、海外投融資政策の変遷を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And your work on the evolution of overseas investment policy — that was significant too?
lines.style: Reflective, a bit more probing. She's genuinely wondering, not just listening. Opens with slight curiosity. Thoughtful pace, giving him room.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、芸術における自虐表現を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I focused on self-deprecating expression in art and how it functions culturally.
lines.style: Quiet resolve closing. He's found ground beneath his feet. The words come steadier now, almost gentle. A natural finish, not rushed.
